About Calendar

Calendar shows your events, and your to-do tasks that have a due time, in month, week, day and agenda views. An event can repeat, be set in any time zone, and warn you before it starts. You can import and export .ics files, and link an event to a customer in CRM. Everything stays in this browser, and nothing is uploaded.
